title: Fantasy Football: 2026-27 Week 5 K Points Leader
description:
This market will resolve to the kicker that finishes Week 5 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season as the highest-scoring K under the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports.

Only games designated by the NFL as Week 5 of the 2026-27 regular season count. If two or more players are tied for the most fantasy points in Week 5, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player whose last name comes first alphabetically.

If the highest-scoring K in Week 5 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is not a listed player, this market will resolve to "Other".

If Week 5 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past October 28, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or a leader cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source will be official Week 5 statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

title: What will the announcers say during the 49ers vs Seahawks game?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed term is mentioned by a play-by-play announcer or a game analyst of the official FOX announce team during the English-language broadcast of the San Francisco 49ers vs Seattle Seahawks game on FOX, scheduled for October 11, 2026 at 4:25 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Pregame coverage, halftime studio coverage, and postgame commentary will not be considered.

For the purpose of this market, the "FOX announce team" refers only to the play-by-play announcer and the game analyst or analysts calling this game from the broadcast booth. Remarks made by sideline reporters, rules or officiating analysts, studio hosts, guest commentators, in-booth guests, players, coaches, or any other individuals will not count toward resolution, including when such remarks air during in-game interviews or in-game segments.

The resolution source for this market is the national FOX telecast of this game. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

For full rules, see: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/market_products/Mentions/Event+Mentions+Contract+DeFi.pdf
